description.en: The puzzle mission on the adventure ship is suitable for children from 6 to approx. 11 years. The accompaniment of an adult is required for safety reasons. The adventure can be booked on the course ship on Wednesdays at 15.15 as well as Sundays at 14.00 and 15.15. Allow a good hour for the adventure. During the Zug school holidays , an adventure ride is even possible every day at 15.15. Allow about an hour for the adventure. At the end, the little ones will receive a surprise from the treasure chest or from the witch's cauldron. Detailed information on the current theme of the adventure ship can be found here.

Held every Sunday on the circular tour, starting at 10.45 a.m., and from 12 April to 3 May and from 27 September to 1 November 2026 at 9.45 a.m. from Zug. Guests who would like to have lunch à la carte are also very welcome on this cruise. When booking online, please note "Lunch à la carte" in the message field.

After instructions from the game master, the guessing begins. The case files are then handed over to the teams formed in advance (ideally 2-6 people per team). The teams have one hour to crack the code together. The game is mainly played at the table, where the case files are analysed to solve the case, and elements on the ship also contribute to the solution. A surprise awaits the winning team. The case file and the announcements during the game will be in German.
Held on the dates listed below. The standard cruise fares apply.
